title: review-tool
description: The commands of the main agent. Each answers one line of JSON and exits with 0 for an answer and 1 for a failure.

oneOf.title: prepare
oneOf.description: prepare <url> <workdir>: starts the review of the change at the URL, keeps it in the workdir, and answers how the review stands.

oneOf.title: status
oneOf.description: status <workdir>: answers how the review kept in the workdir stands.
